subject: general
question: Who is organising the Viksit Bharat Buildathon 2025?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Department of School Education & Literacy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Viksit Bharat Buildathon 2025: Nationwide Innovation Contest for Students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Viksit Bharat Buildathon 2025** is a nationwide **virtual innovation contest** for school students.

 
 
• 
 
Open to **students from Classes 6 to 12** across **six lakh schools** (government and private).

 
 
• 
 
Focus on **self-reliance**, **indigenous knowledge**, and **sustainability**, contributing to **India’s vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047**.

 
 
• 
 
**Organized by**: Department of School Education & Literacy, in collaboration with **Atal Innovation Mission** (NITI Aayog) and **AICTE**.

 
 
• 
 
Builds on the success of **School Innovation Marathon 2024**, leading to initiatives like **Student Innovator Programme (SIP)** and **Student Entrepreneurship Programme (SEP)**.
